issues.title: Collapse new message form on `Submit`
issues.body:
I'm working in the `Tall Msg` wargame.

I open up `New Message` form.  It's showing `Weather report`.

I change the template to `Chat`, enter some text, and `Submit`.

The form then switches to the first template: `Weather`.

When we `Submit`, the form should close, and when we re-open it should still show the previous template type.
